candidate_groups.current_host: FrontendHaptics.selectionFeedback() currently calls UISelectionFeedbackGenerator().selectionChanged() per event, so it does not retain/reuse a generator across calls. Sidebar and ComposerStatusPill share this dispatcher. attachmentImported also constructs UIImpactFeedbackGenerator(style:.light) for each accepted file event.
candidate_groups.safe_product_decision: Retain one lazily created selection generator in the current explicit MainActor frontend haptic adapter, after its existing preference/hardware/active admission; reuse across its selection consumers. This restores the observed per-engine cache mechanism, with existing global frontend adapter scope explicitly independent from original DI lifecycle. Do not hardcode offset0x28 in product code. The known light file-success path can likewise retain a lazily-created .light generator in that same adapter, after admission. A single known-style cache is sufficient now; do not introduce unused styles or alter intensity. If future recovered styles are added, preserve style-distinct cached generators rather than mutating one.
candidate_groups.not_supported: Do not claim caching increases waveform amplitude or proves cause of reported weak feel. Do not increase strength or add prepare-on-begin from this nearby helper alone.
